test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A sum, when invested for 2 years at the rate of 10% per annum at simple interest, amounts to ₹4,800 on maturity. What is the sum invested?
solution:
Given:

Time = 2 years

Rate = 10%

Amount = Rs. 4800

Formula used:- 

Simple interest = A - P

Simple interest = (PRT)/100

Calculation:- 

According to the question,

SI = 4800 - P

⇒ (P × 10 × 2)/100 = 4800 - P

⇒ 20P/100 = 4800 - P

⇒ P/5 + P = 4800

⇒ 6P/5 = 4800

P = (5 × 4800)/6

P = 5 × 800 = Rs. 4000

**∴ The sum invested was Rs. 4000.**
